primary_meaning: An antichristian empire, ruler, or system of political/religious power opposed to God and empowered by Satan (commonly identified as the Antichrist or his kingdom)

alternatives.meaning: The historical Roman Empire (or a specific emperor such as Nero)
A future end-times world leader, dictatorship, or one-world government
The papacy or institutional Roman Catholic Church as a continuing antichristian power
Symbolic of human kingdoms, worldly power, or chaos in general (idealist reading)
Literal wild animals or merely natural ferocity without further political/eschatological reference

notes: Apocalyptic beasts (therion) are widely agreed to represent hostile powers rather than ordinary animals, but no single historical or future referent commands consensus across preterist, historicist, futurist, and idealist schools of Christian interpretation.
